rulings.title: settle does not wait for a seat relaunched on resume
rulings.detail: The wait set is built once from the seats running at the first pass; a seat relaunched on resume is never awaited.
rulings.requirement: PRD 7.2: the judge starts only after every seat has finished, failed or timed out
rulings.reason: Seats added by _relaunch are not in `waiting`.

rulings.title: No unit test for the judge-fallback banner
rulings.detail: No unit test pins the banner text.
rulings.reason: A test gap: regraded from P1 to P2.

rulings.title: judge stdin left open
rulings.detail: The job is started with stdin=DEVNULL.

rulings.title: secret file list includes a world-readable path
rulings.reason: Unchanged since the run's base and named by no PRD or decisions line (base-scope rule).
